(363)༄༅/ /snyan brgyud rin po che'i khrid kyi man ngag mkha' dbyings snying po'i bde khrid bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (363)༄༅// snyan brgyud rin po che'i khrid kyi man ngag mkha' dbyings snying po'i bde khrid bzhugs so//

rdzogs pa chen po sems sde a ro lugs so// (364)༄༅// rgyal ba sku gsum gyi rang bzhin dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// 'di ni bla med theg pa'i gsang chen gnad// zhal las snyan brgyud bde gshegs kun gyi thugs// gegs med nye lam gnyug ma'i de kho na// nye bar snang gi bsgrub la mos pa dag /tshe 'dir chags pa'i rnam bzhag rnams dor nas// rgyal ba dgongs pa'i gsang ba snying po'i don// yi ge med pa'i snyan brgyud 'di zung la// gdod nas gnas pa gdod ma'i sar brnyes mdzod// de la re zhig rje btsun rnam par snang mdzad zhabs kyi man ngag gi snying po snyan brgyud rin po che'i lag khrid la dang po'i ting nge 'dzin// bar gyi ting nge 'dzin/ tha ma'i ting nge 'dzin zhes sgom rim gsum las// dang po la/ bsags pa'i dang*/ sbyong ba'i dang*/ sbrub pa zhes bya'o// dang po ni/ stan la ci bder gnas pas mi rtag pa dran pa sogs 'jug rim sngon du btang la/ skyabs sems dang ldan pas phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya'o// 'di ltar rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i dbyings tshad med par bai ḍūrya maṇḍal dri ma med pa lta bu/ (365)chos kyi dbyings shin tu rnam par dag pa ye shes kyi rang bzhin rtsibs stong dang ldan pa'i gser gyi 'khor lo dang*/ me long ye shes kyi ngo bo bai ḍūrya rdo rje dang*/ mnyam pa nyid kyi rang bzhin nor bu rin po che dang*/ so sor rtog pa'i rang bzhin padma 'dab ma brgya pa dang*/ bya ba grub pa'i rang bzhin sna tshogs rdo rje dang re re zhing yang rgya khyon tshad med pa// lha dang mi'i skye bo du ma dag gis brten gnas su gyur pa mchod pa'i yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bkod pas/ phyogs kyi khong ma lus pa kun tu gang ba gsal bar dmigs la/ der rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa spyan drangs/ de yang nam mkha'i mthil du rgyal ba kun bzang ye shes kyi sku/

shar du rang byung rig pa'i sku/ lhor chos dbyings stong pa'i sku/ nub tu lhun gyis grub pa'i sku/ byang du 'gag med gsal ba'i sku rnams yang dag par bkod la/ sngar bkod pa'i rdzas de dag dbul zhing bsod nams su bya ba mtha' dag zhib tu bsgom zhing dmigs med du bsdu ba'o// slar yang spyi mgrin snying khar oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes rab tu bkod de sems bzung la// hūm̐ gi 'od kyis phyi nang (366)thams cad nam mkha' ltar byas nas yi ge gsum gyi lus su blta'o// de bzhin du a yi 'od kyis brtan pa dang g.yo ba mtha' dag rab tu gsal bar gyur pa dang*/ oṃ gyi 'od kyis shin tu rnam par dag pa'i dngos nyid du byas la/ oṃ badzra st+wa oṃ zhes rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa'/ spyi bo'i nang khongs su'ang de dang ldan par blta'o// oṃ badzra st+wa ā zhes 'jig rten mtha' dag sngags kyi sgras bkang ste/ mgrin bar rdo rje sems dpa' dmar po dang*// oṃ badzra st+wa hūm̐ zhes snying gar rdor sems sngon po dang*/ zla ba rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ lnga ldan bsgoms la/ de so so'i 'od kyis 'gro ba ma lus pa'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma sbyangs te rigs gsum rdo rje sems dpar gyur pa dang*/ yi ge brgya pa'i sgra dbyangs kyi dang*/ dbyings ye shes ro mnyam nyid kyi don la sems bzhag rnams bya zhing sngags bzla/ bsdu ba'i rim pas sdud pa'o// de nas mdun gyi nam mkhar 'dab rgyas padmo'i ze'u 'brur zla ba nyi ma la/ bla ma yi dam rje btsun rnam par snang mdzad kun tu bzang po nya rgyas zla ba las lhag par dkar ba'i sku/ mnyam gzhag byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can rgyan du ma dang ldan pa la rigs bzhi'i kun bzang sogs bder gshegs du mas bskor ba dmigs la mchod pas mchod de gsol ba drag tu gdab par bya'o// de'i smin mtshams nas 'od zer bye ba khrag khrig bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung*/

rang gi lus mtha' dag tu thim/ sgrib pa dag /dbang thob/ ye shes mngon du byas/ zer zer phran 'jig rten mtha' dag khyab/ thams cad mchog tu dri ma med par byas zhes nges pa rab tu brtan par bkod de/ bsngo ba smon lam byas la/ ci bder mchod do bya ba ni rnam pa gcig la/ nges pa brtan pa nyid kyis ting nge 'dzin phyi ma la 'jug go zhes bya ba ni gzhan no// mdor na de dag ni dang po'i (367)ting nge 'dzin te/ rdo rje sems dpa'i sgrub pa rgyas pa dang*/ padma dbyings phyug ma sgrub pa dang*/ las rgya mtsho'i rim pa rnams gzhan du rtogs par bya yi/ las dang po pa'i khrid rim dang ma 'brel zhing dbang rnon ngo sprod pa'ang*/ dang por 'kho ba ma yin no zhes shes par byos shig /da ni bar gyi ting nge 'dzin dngos kyi rang bzhin la re zhig rnam pa bzhi ste/ lta ba thabs kyis bzung ba/ lta ba nyams su myong ba/ lta ba lam du slong ba/ lta ba ngo sprod pa zhes bya'o// dang po la gnyis/ rgyu tshogs la gnas par bya ba dang*/ rnal 'byor gyi zas bdun brten pa'o// dang po ni/ sgo gsum rnam par g.yo ba'i rkyen las 'khor bar 'khrul te/ g.yo ba med pa las rang gi de kho na nyid rtogs par 'gyur ro// de bas na rkyen dang bral bar lhur blangs te/ lus 'gul ba med pa dang*/ ngag smra ba med pa dang*/ sems dran bsam med pa la yun ring du gnas par bya dgos pas/ lus bsam gtan gyi chos dang ldan pa la/ rlung btang bzung med pa dang*/ sems spro bsdu'i rgyun gcod la gnas par bya'o// zla ba lnga'am zhag nyer gcig la sogs pa'i bar du bsgom par bya ste/ 'di ni tshogs gnas so// rnal 'byor gyi zas brten pa ni/ khams reg gnyid sems rnam par shes// ting 'dzin tshangs spyod rnam pa bdun// zhes pa'i dang po ni dug tu 'gyur ba spangs te mthun pa bsten pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ 'jam yang la sogs pa bsten no// gsum pa ni/

nyin spangs te mtshan bsten no// bzhi pa ni/ yid du 'ong ba dag go /lnga pa ni/ 'dod pa'i yon tan lhag ma snga ma bzhin lam du byed pa'o// drug pa ni/ sems gtad so cung zad kyang med par phyad de/ lhod de/ phyam me/ wal le bzhag pa'o// bdun pa ni/ log (368)pa bgrod pa spang ba ste// 'di ltar zas kyis khams gso zhing tshogs la gnas pa ni bsgrub bya dngos so// de las dang po g.yo ba'i nyams sna tshogs 'char/ de nas thob pa'i nyams sna tshogs 'char/ slar gnas pa de goms pas nyams yun du sdod pa 'byung*/ de nas brtan pa'i nyams ci tsam 'dod 'dod du gnas pa 'byung ste/ nyams rnam pa bzhi po 'di nyams su myong na lta ba nyams su myong ba zhes bya'o// lam du slong ba ni/ ting nge 'dzin du ma'i sgo nas dang*// rlung gi sgo nas te/ ting nge 'dzin mtshan bcas 'phrod pa'i rigs kyis zlum po dkar po/ gru bzhi ser po/ zur gsum dmar po/ zla gam ljang gu/ sngo sang zlum po rnams dang*/ 'khor lo/ rin chen/ padma/ rgya gram/ rdo rje rnams dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā sogs la sems gtad pa'o// mtshan med 'phrod pa'i rigs kyis ci la'ang mi sems par bzhag pa'o// bskyed rim 'phrod pa'i rigs yod do// rlung ni 'jam rlung dang*/ rtsub pa la/ lte ba'am/ snying gar mar me lta bu bsgom pa/ mar me'i snying po lta bu la bsgom pa dang*/ spyi gtsug gam/ snying*/ lte bar pa wa sangs lta bu thig le bsgom pa rlung sems 'dres pa'i thig le la bzung ba dang*/ steng 'og gi rlung lcags kyu grol mdud ltar bya la/ sbrul mdud lta bu la bzung ba rnams steng 'og gi rlung 'jam po bde lugs dang*/ 'gogs med dang sbyar ba dang bzhi'o// skyil krung sa gnon la rlung drag tu bzung*/ nam mkhar rang nyid gdugs dkar gyi steng na gnas pa 'khor bar bsgom pa dang*/ 'khor lo la yang de ltar bya bas/ gdugs la brten pa dang*/ 'khor lo la brten pa zhes rtsub pa'o// de la sogs pa thabs du mas bslang ngo*// skabs 'di'am/

thabs bzung gi skabs su/ brdal ba nam mkha' bzhin/ btang ba spre'u (369)bzhin/ zin pa phye bzhin/ rnyogs med chu bzhin/ dran pa bzhin/ bor ba bzhin/ snyegs pa bzhin/ bcad pa bzhin no// zhes brgyad po bzhag thabs kyi rnal 'byor te/ bcad ces bya ba ni mtha'i dri ma bco brgyad bcad de/ btsal na stor/ bkag na nyams/ bcos na bslad/ bsgom na 'chal/ rtsol na bral/ dgug na bros/ lta na yal/ dran na yengs/ myang na shor/ gzob na 'dres/ bgrod na 'khyams/ nga'o snyam na ltung*/ rtog go snyam na stong*/ sems la rnam rtog langs na phung*/ gtang 'dzin byed na gnad cing brlag /byung tshor gyi rjes su 'brengs na 'khor/ bying rmug gi dbang du song na 'thib/ spang blang byed na 'dzol zhes te tha ma kho nar bsdus so// lta ba ngo sprad pa ni/ dang por gser gyi brag ri g.yu yis brgyan pa'i rtser gser gyi mchod rten 'od gsal ba bsgom ste/ yid la gsal na de phyogs bcu gang na gnas pa/ de phyogs gang nas der 'ong*/ phyogs gang du 'gro zhes dang*/ nang lus kyi phyogs la yang de ltar te/ shar na gnas sam/ shar nas byung ngam/ shar du song ngam zhes gsum gyis phye ba'am/ rnam dbye du mas btsal lo// de nas rmi lam du de lta bu rmis pa de zhes snga ma ltar brtags pa dang*/ de dag ji lta bar dngos su gser ri mchod rten gyis brgyan pa yang zhes brtag go /gser ris mtshon nas sa ci snyed pa ste/ sgom snang*/ gnyid snang*/ dngos snang gsum las rim bzhin blta'o// de bzhin du/ chu/ me/ rlung*/ mkha' dang*/ dmyal ba/ yi dwags/ dud 'gro/ mi/ lha min/ lha rnams dang*/ gnyen dgra sogs kyis mtshon nas/ 'dod chags/ zhe sdang*/ gti mug /nga rgyal/ phrag dog dang*/ 'das pa dang*/ ma 'ongs pa dang*/ (370)da lta'i sangs rgyas rnams dang*/ gnas dus/ ston/ 'khor/ chos rnams la/ sgom/ rmi/ dngos gsum gyis gtan la dbab ste/ nges pa mthong mthong du bya'o// de thams cad byung song gnas pa med pas/

rang bzhin med pas/ med kyang rnam par snang tsam/ rtag chad yod med kyi 'dzin pa las grol ba'i mthong ba skyes na ngo 'phrod pa ste/ sprod 'phrad bral rlung zhugs shes 'byung ngo*// 'byung lnga rang byung skye med du ngo sprad/ 'gro drug rang byung skye med du ngo sprad// dug lnga rang byung*/ sangs rgyas rang byung*/ phun tshogs rang byung skye med du ngo sprod ces lnga po 'di dang*/ gzhan yang ci rigs su shes par bya'o// yang na snang ba sems/ sems stong pa/ stong pa gnyis med/ gnyis med rang grol zhes ngo sprad/ yang na 'og gi rdzong bzhis ngo sprad kyang rung ste/ gang la'ang yang yang dri zhing thag bcad par bya ba ni gnad do// gnad kyis bzhag pa dang*/ rang gnas pa dang*/ rang 'phro ba rnams khyad med du grol bar mthong na nges pa rnyed bzhes bya ste/ de lta bu ni bar gyi ting nge 'dzin no// mtha'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ bsre ba gsum dang man ngag nyi shu ste/ lus ngag yid kyi kun spyod 'gro 'dug smra sems ma lus pa dang sbyar te bsgom pa/ nyin par las dang bya ba dang bsre ba zhes bya'o// mtshan bcas ltar na/ snying khar oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā sogs la sbyar te bsgom pa dang*/ lta ba mthong ba'i ngang las ma g.yos par gnyid pas 'od gsal lam/ rmi lam gyis bsgom pas 'grub ste mtshan mo gnyid dang rmi lam dang bsre zhes bya'o// 'od kyi gong bu sogs 'phen 'dun gyis sbyor ba'am/ skye 'gag med pa'i gshis la blo nges pas don bsgrubs la/ 'chi dus shes rab phar phyin dang bsre zhes de ltar bsre ba gsum la bsgom bdag gtod ces kyang bya'o// dran pa gdod nas dran (371)med du gnas pa rang gsal ba dang*/ shar snang ji snyed pa de nyid du nges pa dang*/ shar grol mnyam pa dang*/ gdod ma'i babs rnams la rdzong zhes// dran pa gzhi bzhengs lta ba'i rdzong*// mthong tshe de nyid sgom pa'i rdzong*// thug 'phrad rang grol spyod pa'i rdzong*// skye ba med de 'bras bu'i rdzong*// zhes bya ba yin no// thams cad du dran 'dzin brtan pa dang*/

nyin mtshan snga phyi bar gyi dus bzhi'am/ thun bzhir bsgom la brtson pa dang*/ lus ngag yid lhug pa las mi g.yo ba dang*/ ngo sprod kyi tshig bzhi gnad la dbab pa rnams rdzong la 'jug pa'i lam 'phrang ste/ dang po nyams len mkhan gyis dgos so zhes/ shes bya rtsis zin lta ba'i 'phrang*// dus bzhi mnyam sbyor sgom pa'i 'phrang*// sgo gsum rang grol spyod pa'i 'phrang*// gab pa'i tshig bzhi 'bras bu'i 'phrang*// zhes bya'o// ngo sprod mchog thob pa de 'phrang dang rdzong mi dgos par snang srid yangs pa chos sku'i klong du grol lo zhes/ gcig shes kun grol lta ba'i klong*// zab mo nyams drug sgom pa'i klong*// tshor ba rjes med spyod pa'i klong*// byar med blo 'das 'bras bu'i klong*// zhes so// de la brtan pa thob pas gding du 'gyur te/ rang byung ye shes lta ba'i gding*// ye shes rang sa bsgom pa'i gding*// ye shes zang thal spyod pa'i gding*// ye shes spyi blugs 'bras bu'i gding*// zhes so// de nyid lha bzhir grub ste/ skye med tshig gcig lta ba'i lha// shes bya gcig chod sgom pa'i lha// 'da' ka 'chi brod spyod pa'i lha// dbul mo gter 'phrad 'bras bu'i lha// zhes bya ba rnams yin no// 'jigs med phyogs med kyi rig pa la// phyogs 'dzin gyi lta bas ci bgyi// rang sems chos nyid kyi dkyil 'khor la// dmigs gtad kyi sgom pas ci bgyi// ci byed byang (372)sems kyi cho 'phrul la// bzang ngan gyi spyod pas ci bgyi// rnam rtog rang byung gi ye shes la// spong 'gegs kyi 'khrul bas ci bgyi// thams cad ye dag gi ngo bo la// sgrub 'dod kyi 'ching bas ci bgyi// rang sems sangs rgyas kyi rgyal po la// gsar thob kyi 'bras bus ci bgyi// zhes zab mo'i tshig drug ste/ de nyams su myong bar bya'o// rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i mchod pa/

sna tshogs bdun/ maṇḍal gsol 'debs rnams dang ldan pas/ snang ba rnams rang grol du ngo sprod pa rgyal thabs spyi blugs kyi dbang snga phyi bsre ba'i shes pa sogs med par rig pa rang gsal mar me'i snying po ltar ngo sprad pa rig pa rang gsal gyi dbang*/ nam mkha' lta bu ye ji bzhin pa'i chos nyid bsam bral du ngo sprad pa ye shes spyi blugs kyi dbang ste gsum po cho gar byas kyang rung*/ ngo sprod rnal ma thob nas nges shes skyes na cho ga med kyang thob ste/ bskur thob/ ma bskur thob sogs mu bzhis shes so// des snyan brgyud rin po che bsdus te lag tu len tshul yin la/ rgyas par gdab dpung cha lag dang bcas par rgyas par gsal bas der blta'o// rab yangs lta ba'i mkha' la spyod 'dod na// ji bzhin lta ba mngon du byed pa'i gnad// mgon po rnam par snang mdzad thugs kyi bcud// yang dag nges pa'i gsang 'di bsgom par mdzod// gang dag phyogs zhen dri mas sbags blo can// zab mo'i chos la gshed ma ltar mthong ba// de 'dra'i smra bas grol ba'i sgo 'gegs te// khyed cag 'bad de bsam mi khyab dran bya'o// gang 'di sangs rgyas kun gyis phyag mdzad do// legs par grub pa rin chen dam pa'i chos// log par mthong smra dmyal ba'i lcags kyu che// gang la bsnun pa nyams byed 'jigs su rung*// phung khrol dbyig brtsegs de 'dra mi mthong zhing*// mi thos mi dran yang na de yi gnyen// smin grol bla med rab spyin nyid (373)gyur te// 'gro kun mchog gi lta la sbyor gyur cig /snyan brgyud rin po che'i khrid kyi man ngag mkha' dbyings snying po'i bde khrid ces bya ba/ dpal mkha' spyod pas chu bo gaṅgā gser ldan dang nye ba'i ljongs su bris pa'o// rnam pa snang mdzad/ gzhon nu ye shes/ a ro ye shes 'byung gnas/ bsod nams snying po/ dpal ldan

dus gsum shes bya kun mkhyen rin chen zhes bya ba ni nye brgyud do/ gzhan ni sna tshogs so// maṅga laṃ// ༈ byang sems snying po'i pra khrid bzhugs so// lhun grub byang sems bsgom par mos na/ sngon 'gro snyan brgyud nyid dang mthun te// dngos gzhi la sngon du shes pas mtha' bcad pa paṇḍi ta'i lugs dang*/ ku sgom pa kho na su lu'i lugs las 'di phyi ma'o// de la sems bzung ba/ sems lam du blang ba/ dang po la bzung thabs zin rtags las/ dang po skyil krung sa gnon/ rlung yid tsam bcing ba'am rgya yan la sems rten med du bzhag cing*/ gdugs dang 'khor lo yang 'og rlung drag dang sbyor la drag tu bsgoms te/ zhi drag gi rnal 'byor ro// lcags sbub tu chu 'dus pa ltar 'dus lta bu/ me stags 'phro ba shar yal lta bu/ rtswa mchog bser bus gdung ba lus 'dar lta bu/ rus sbal mkhar gzhor 'phro mi nus pa lta bu/ rgun snye ba la ba mer mer 'phro lta bu/ dri bzhon dal gyis ldang ba g.yo yang med pa ltar gsal yang mi 'gyu ba lta bu dang drug go /sems bzung ba'i man ngag go /dha thim/ gnyis pa la/ gzhi snying po'i don/ lam rtogs pa'i don/ 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i don las// gzhi la/ yin/ snang*/ shar gsum/ 'di ltar snang srid 'khor 'das su snang ba 'di thams cad chos nyid yin/ de nyid du snang*/ de nyid shar zhes rgyas par ngo sprod pa'i man ngag /dha thim/ lam la 'khor ba lugs 'byung dang lugs ldog (374)gnyis las/ dang por rang gis rang bcings/ dar srin nam rgyal bu ltar rang gis rang ma rig ste/ rgyu lhan skyes kyi ma rig pa/ rkyen kun brtags kyi ma rig pa/ 'bras bu 'gro ba rigs drug /nyes pa sdug bsngal/ rang ma rtogs pa nyid/ dpe thag sbrul dar srin sogs chos drug ldan lugs 'byung ste/ gdams ngag gis bzlog par bya ba la/ gdams ngag 'debs tshul/ brtson 'grus can tshe 'dir btab pas grol ba dang*/

le lo can 'chi khar btab pas grol ba'o/ dang po lta/ sgom/ spyod pa ste/ lta ba gding med bya sgro rlung khyer lta bu/ 'jug sgo lam bral lag rdum brag 'dzegs/ spyod pa grogs med dmus long mthar 'khyams gsum spangs la/ lta ba gding ldan khyung chen mkhar lding*/ 'jug sgo lam ldan gar spyin sbrang 'byar/ spyod pa grogs bcas bi shwa karma rnams shes par bya/ lta ba bkol btub/ sgom pa lam slong*/ spyod pa shugs 'byung ces pa dgos la/ lta ba kha tshig /bsgom pa rtsa ba hral/ spyod pa tshul 'chos su ma shor ba gal che'o// lta sgom spyi'i go don no// dha thim/ 'di ltar snang ba 'di thams cad phan pa phyogs gcig tu grub pa'ang med/ gnod pa phyogs gcig tu grub pa'ang med/ snang ba phyogs gcig /mun pa phyogs gcig /sman phyogs gcig /dug phyogs gcig tu grub pa'ang med/ sa mig la gnod de/ sa bon la phan/ mi'i snang ba/ 'byung po'i mun pa/ mi'i dug /rma bya'i sman/ de bas na chos thams cad ji ltar snang yang rang sems zhes bya'o// rang sems de gzugs sgra dri ro sogs ma rnyed de stong pa/ stong pa de rang bzhin/ sna tshogs de rang rtsal/ de gnyis gdod nas gnyis med ro mnyam/ gnyis med de ye nas rang grol bas de nyid sangs rgyas chen po zhes bya'o// 'od gsal zhes (375)kyang bya'o// ming sna tshogs so// lta ba bzhi sbyor du ngo sprod pa'i man ngag go /brda thim/ man ngag gi gnad btsal ba'i thos pa bya ba/ g.yeng ba dor ba/ 'du 'dzi spang ba/ mtha' gnyis spang ba/ zas gos/ yo byad bcang ba/ phyi nang gi dgon pa bsten pa ste/ sngon 'gro bzhis sgom chas su gzhug pa'i man ngag go /dha thim/ stan la lus gnad bcas la lta thog tu bzhag la lta bas mtshams sbyar te bsgom pa/ lus kho na srang du bcug ste bya ba sgo bcad pa'i mtshams sbyor/ lus gnad/ ngag dbyangs/ sems lta gsum ka dang ldan/ sgo gsum gyi mtshams sbyor zhes rab 'bring tha ma'i mtshams sbyor gsum gsum man ngag go

/dha thim/ nam mkha'i mtshan nyid dpe// sems kyi mtshan nyid don/ gnyis med chos kyi chos nyid du ngo sprad pa nyid gsum bsre ba'i man ngag go /btang ste 'gro sar/ log na legs par btsal ba sems 'tshol ba rjes med kyi man ngag go /kun gzhi sgo lnga rtog med du bzhag pa yid phra ma mkhan bskyar 'don gyi man ngag go /lus bor thabs so// sems yal thabs ni byang sems cog bzhag ma'i man ngag ste zab/ man ngag bzhis bsgom dngos ngo sprad pa// dha thim/ khyung chen mkha' lding*/ thi bya tshang 'jug /bya btang skyes bu gsum ni bzhag thabs so// bying rgod byung na/ khyim stong gi rkun mo ltar bcos/ sngags gsad dug ltar bcos/ nam mkha' sprin ltar bcos pa rnams rab lta bas bcos pa/ gos zas gnas sogs/ 'bring spyod lam gyis/ lus la bde ba skyes pa ri bo zhags bzhi/ ljon pa'i rtser gnas/ nam mkha' yongs dag /stong pa sgo 'byed bzhi dang*/ ngag la skye ba glu dbyangs sogs/ sems la skye ba snying kha'i thig le dkar rnams bying ba bcos pa/ 'jug (376)pa'i sgo dgag /'gro ba'i lam bcad/ gnas pa'i phug rdibs bas gsum/ rgod sel te khyi'us 'byin lta bu/ tha ma gdams ngag gis bcos pa ste/ bcos thabs gsum gyi man ngag go /rta dmu rgod ltar gcun/ rin chen gter ltar// rgyal po'i btsun mo ltar zhes gcun thabs gsum mo// mar me/ rgya mtsho/ shing bal gsum tshad gsum mo// lus/ dbugs/ rteg gsum du yod du mi tshor drod gsum mo// lung ston/ mngon shes/ snang ba lam slong rnams phyi nang gsang ba rtags gsum mo// de ltar bzhag thabs nas rtags kyi bar thabs drug gis bsgom gyi gzhung bsrang ba'i man ngag go /dha thim/ lus stong pa snyam byed/ ye med pa snyam byed/ dum bu tsam las med pa snyam byed phyi'i rtags thabs gsum/ sa le yod pa snyam/ sangs kyis song ba snyam/ phyad kyis song ba snyam nang gi gsum/ mer mer/

chil chil/ dga' ya le gsum ni gsang ba'i/ rig pa rang grol ba mthar thug gi gcig ste bsgom snang bcus bsgom ngos bzung ba'o// brda thim/ gsung rab lta ba sogs lta bas bskyed gdon/ dben par sngags spyod/ bya ba gsang spyod/ goms nas phyag rgya lhan cig kun tu rgyu ba rigs spyod spyod pas bskyed gdon pa/ sha lnga sogs bsten pa bdud rtsis bskyed gdon pa ste bogs 'don gsum mo// brda thim/ phung po'i bdud lam gyi gzhi/ nyon bdud lam dngos/ lha bu lam grogs/ 'chi bdag lam gyi rgyan du bya ba bdud bzhi rnam rgyal// brda thim/ nyin par las dang bya ba// mtshan mo gnyid rmi lam mtshams su ye shes bzhi sbyor dang bsre zhes bsre thabs gsum/ dha thim/ bying rgod bcos pas so skye'i gol sa gcod/ rtag chad bral bas mu stegs gol sa gcod/ blos byas zhig pas skye mched mu bzhi'i gol sa (377)gcod// thi bya ltar ram thos bsam gyis theg chen bsam gtan gyi gol sa gcod de gol sa gzhi bcad pa'o// brda thim/ 'phral gyi phan yon/ yun gyi phan yon/ yon tan thams cad 'dus pa'i phan yon/ tshegs chung don che'i phan yon te phan yon bzhi'o// dha thim/ de ltar sgom chas su gzhug pa/ sgom mtshams sbyor ba/ sgom dngos bstan pa/ sgom gzhung bsrang ba/ sgom ngos bzung ba/ sgom bogs 'don pa/ sgom bdud las rnam rgyal/ sgom don la bsre ba/ sgom gol sa chad pa/ sgom dpal yon phun tshogs zhes don bcus/ sgom zhib tshags su gdab pa'o// dha thim/ gtad med smyon pa lta bu/ zhen bral bu chung lta bu/ chad med 'on lkugs lta bu gsum shes rab dang mthun pa'i spyod pa/ spang blang 'jug ldog ci ltar rigs rigs su bya ba thabs dang mthun pa'i spyod pa/ g.yo sgyu zol zog med/ gnas lugs dang sgo gsum rgyun gyi spyod pa ste rnam gsum spyod pa'i 'khor lo'o// dha thim/ lta ba mnyam nyid bzhi sbyor la// sgom pa chings bcu'i rgyan dang ldan// spyod pa ye shes gsum skor gyis// 'khor ba bde chen 'khor lo bskor/

zhes so// 'chi tshul shes par bya ba 'chi ba rjes dran/ gang la'ang snying po med par nges pa skyes pa rjes dran/ 'chi ba skyes pa'i chos nyid du nges nas zhen 'khris skrag sogs btang ba gtong ba rjes dran/ snang ba thams cad sna tshogs gsal ba'i lha/ rang rig byang sems bde chen gyi lha/ 'khor ba ye dag snying po'i lhar nges pa lha rjes dran/ da lta dngos kyi bar do/ 'chi dus 'chi ka bar do/ shi nas srid pa bar do gsum dbyer med du nges pa bar do rjes dran/ sngags bsgom pa/ bar do shar ba/ dran pa ye shes gsum gcig tu 'dres pa don gsum gcig dril gyi man ngag zhes bya ste/ (378)chos nyid rjes dran no// rjes dran drug gis 'chi khar btab grol gyi man ngag go /brda thim/ da lta gdab grol/ 'chi khar gdab grol gnyis kyis lam rtogs pa'i don/ dha thim/ bde chen byang chub kyi sems 'di nyid sangs rgyas kyi dngos gzhi'am ngo bo'o// de yi rtsal dag snang can la longs sku/ 'khrul snang can la sprul sku du ma ste rnam pa'o// chos thams cad de nyid du rtogs pa mthar phyin pa ni thob pa'o// rab 'dir/ 'bring 'chi kha'i bar do// tha ma skye ba gsum mam bdun tshun nges pa ste dus so// de ltar sangs rgyas kyi ngo bo// rnam pa/ thob tshul/ dus mtshams bzhis 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i don no// brda thim/ gzhi ni gnyug ma snying po'i don// lam ni rang grol rtogs pa'i don// 'bras bu ye dag rdzogs pa'i don/ don gsum snying po byang chub lam// zhes bya'o// de ltar man ngag snying po gnad la phab pa ste lam du bya'o// sems nyid lam du byed pa la// kun bzang byang sems snying po'i lam// lam rnams kun gyi rgyal po mchog /'di ni gsang chen snying po'i bcud// e ma ho grogs dag brtson pa'i dpal// ha cang 'phel ba de lta na'ang*// mthong shes rtogs pas grol med par// grol ba rnams sbyin 'dis tshim byos// snyan brgyud rin po che byang sems snying po'i pra khrid ces bya ba dpal mkha' spyod pas rtsa ba dang mthun par gangs can lho phyogs kyi rgyud du bris pa'o/// /
